reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code, promo_name, promo_type, discount_pct
FROM promotions
WHERE (promo_name ILIKE '%spring%' OR promo_name ILIKE '%audio%')
  AND promo_type = 'percent_off'
alternatives:

FROM promotions
WHERE promo_type = 'percent_off'
  AND (promo_name ILIKE '%audio%' OR promo_name ILIKE '%spring%')
